verdict.rationale: Obsidian's first-party docs describe Obsidian URI, a custom URI protocol that lets external callers open or create notes, which covers the core of driving the app from scripts. Because notes are plain local Markdown files, scripts can also act on vault content directly. Missing for 10: detail on URI parameters and actions beyond open/create, any local HTTP/API endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration of URI-based automation.
